about: Official pages for US and Canadian parks POTA lists with no website (HQ worklist, Oct 25 2026: KPC_Park_OfficialPages_done.xlsx). web = the park's own page (filled into data/parkinfo by kpc_state_links.py when POTA has none); agency_page = a general agency list reused for several parks (not the park's own page); map = official map link. NOT FOUND parks are left for later; Canada added Oct 25 from HQ round 10 (KPC_Round10_done.xlsx tab 3). Oct 26: the LINK HARVESTER (kpc_link_harvest.py, monthly) adds 'web' / 'map' from official sources with '<kind>_by': 'bot: …'; a value without a bot tag was filled by a person and is never changed. Oct 26 (HQ): official maps for the 300 busiest US parks outside KY, two research files merged (KPC_Official_Maps_done + KPC_Round12_park_maps_done): map = the park's map (a PDF wins when the two files differ), map_page = the other file's link, map_confirmed = both files gave the same link, map_note 'map on the park page' when the map link is the park page, agency_map = a general agency map page used for 3+ parks (agency-level). Oct 26 11:30 (research desk verdict): 12 fixes applied (map_fix); group_site = the managing group's / support group's own site (not an agency); map_hold = do not show until kpc_map_linkcheck.py says the link loads (it clears the hold itself); map_check = {status, date} for every map / map_page / agency_map link. Oct 26: the LINK HARVESTER (kpc_link_harvest.py, monthly) adds 'web' / 'map' from official sources with '<kind>_by': 'bot: …'; a value without a bot tag was filled by a person and is never changed.
